hero.headline: Split smarter. Track everything.
hero.subheadline: The modern way to manage shared expenses — from group trips to daily coffee splits. Beautiful, fast, and built for friends.

useCases.sectionSubtitle: Whether it's a Goa trip, monthly rent, or Tuesday turf — Trevio handles it all.

trips.title: Group Trips
trips.desc: Split hotels, food, fuel, and activities across multiple people. See who owes what at any point.

household.title: Household & Rent
household.desc: Track rent, groceries, utilities, and maintenance. Split by room size, equal, or custom shares.

turf.title: Turf & Sports
turf.desc: Recurring turf bookings, match fees, and equipment. Set it once, Trevio splits it every week.

roommates.title: Roommates
roommates.desc: Shared groceries, internet, cleaning, and more. Monthly settlement reminders keep it fair.

events.title: Events & Parties
events.desc: Birthday splits, dinner parties, concert tickets. Collect contributions upfront or settle after.

daily.title: Daily Splits
daily.desc: Coffee runs, lunch splits, auto rides. Quick-log and split in seconds. No group needed.

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to manage money with friends
features.sectionSubtitle: Powerful features wrapped in a beautiful, intuitive design.

splitMethods.title: Every split method
splitMethods.desc: Equal, exact amounts, percentages, or shares. Recurring expenses for weekly turf or monthly rent.

settlement.title: One-tap UPI settlement
settlement.desc: Simplified balances show who pays whom. Settle via UPI deep link or mark as cash — all tracked.

budgets.title: Budgets & insights
budgets.desc: Set monthly budgets, track category spending, and get Smart Nudges before you overspend.

wrapped.title: Year-in-review Wrapped
wrapped.desc: See your spending story — top categories, biggest trips, most-split expenses, and savings streaks.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.desc: Set up weekly turf, monthly rent, or subscription splits. Trevio auto-logs them so you don't have to.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: No internet? No problem. Log expenses anywhere, sync automatically when you're back online.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: No setup. No spreadsheets. Just sign in and start splitting.
howItWorks.step1Desc: One tap and you're in. No passwords, no forms, no friction.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Add friends, name your group — trip, household, turf, anything. Start logging expenses.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Trevio calculates who owes what. Settle via UPI or cash. Done.
